title: Aug-AFRAD preparation: augmentation scripts, hand-drawn defect masks, and dataset curation records
description:
Preparation materials for Aug-AFRAD, derived from the AFRAD magnetic tile dataset. This release contains the components that can be redistributed; AFRAD images and their augmented derivatives are not included because redistribution permission has not been obtained.

Contents

  • augmentation_methods/ - deterministic photometric augmentation and mask-guided defect copy-paste
  • manual_defect_masks/ - 79 hand-drawn defect masks (47 crack, 32 folds) stored as TIFF
  • dataset_curation/ - screening records for 47 label conflicts and 28 multi-defect images

Provenance

Source dataset: AFRAD, https://wangh257.github.io/AFRAD/data_download.html (Wang et al., 2025, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.measurement.2025.116702).

Licensing

The scripts in augmentation_methods/ are released under the MIT License. The mask files and curation records are released under CC BY 4.0. The record-level license shown here applies to the masks and curation records.
notes: The augmentation scripts require Pillow; see requirements.txt. AFRAD images are not redistributed in this release.
